title: Athi Srestaneeyuda – Praveen Ritmos, Prudhvi Raj Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఆరాధనకు యోగ్యుడా నీవే మా స్తుతుల స్తోత్రార్హుడా
పదివేలలో అతి సుందరుడా నీవే మా పూజ్యనీయుడ
english: Aaraadhanaku yogyudaa neeve maa sthuthula sthothraahudaa
padhivelalo athi sundharudaa neeve maa poojyaneeyudaa
Thandri deva thandri deva neeve athisrestudavu

intro: Athi Srestaneeyuda is the latest Telugu Christian Christmas song written, tuned & sung by Prudhvi Raj featuring Praveen Ritmos and music composed by Sareen Imman. This song was released on August 16, 2024 through Praveen Ritmos YouTube channel.
